sections.text: Industrial unit conversion is essential for engineers, technicians, and professionals working across different measurement systems. Whether you are converting pressure from PSI to bar or torque from Nm to lb-ft, accuracy matters. Our unit converter covers 18 categories including pressure, torque, energy, power, force, density, angle, frequency, viscosity, hardness, temperature, length, weight, volume, speed, area, data storage, and cooking. Each category supports multiple units with a consistent formula: multiply the input value by the source unit's conversion factor and divide by the target unit's factor.
